title: The Caerns of New York State
summary: Four caerns and two hidden holy sites.

claims.text: New York State holds four caerns: a small one on Goat Island at Niagara Falls, one in Central Park, one in the Sentinel Range of the Adirondacks, and the strongest in the Finger Lakes near Rochester.
Two more holy sites in the Catskills could become caerns but are guarded by faeries.
The Goat Island sept is open, led by Bull Roarer, an Uktena of the Tuscarora reservation; Fianna won a share after helping free the falls from Wyrm agents who walled them off in the 19th century.
Sixty years ago the Fianna removed an Uktena leader who tried to close the caern to outsider tribes.

title: The Caern of the Hand of Gaia
summary: The great Finger Lakes caern near Rochester.

claims.text: Wendigo, Uktena and Croatan shamans raised the Caern of the Hand of Gaia to honour the Finger Lakes; after the Garou briefly lost it, a force of many tribes led by the Children of Gaia won it back and has kept it since.
Garou credit the caern for the region's long run of reformers, dreamers and visionaries.
Heaven, run by the Silver Fang Loba Carcassone and the Heaven pack, is a hidden chain of safe houses and vehicles across North America that spirits abused children to safety.
The sept keeps small groups of Garou in Rochester and Syracuse who work with local citizens' groups.

title: The City
summary: How Garou see New York City.

claims.text: Most Garou, apart from Glass Walkers and Bone Gnawers, call New York City simply The City and see it as the world's greatest Hellhole.
It stands as the Weaver's greatest work on Earth, the richest pattern packed into the smallest space.
Its parks, Central Park above all, are powerful weavings of plant essence that cleanse the city's spirit, much as a wetland cleans water, and keep it from falling wholly to the Wyrm.

title: The Caern of the Sentinel
summary: An Adirondack caern fought over by two tribes.

claims.text: The Get of Fenris claim the Caern of the Sentinel in the Adirondacks; the Shadow Lords once took it with Uktena help but lost it again when the two could not agree on its use.
Twenty-three Shadow Lords under the stern Sylvan-Ivanovich-Sylvan now mean to retake it alone and prove themselves the greatest tribe.
They base themselves in a deep cavern, once a tourist attraction, that they closed to humans with staged cave-ins.
